name: sshi_fbr_filter
rationale: The previous best design 'sshi_fbr' failed only on the ripple constraint for the strong excitation case (S3), with a vpp of 61 mV vs the 50 mV limit. To reduce ripple without significantly increasing the storage capacitor (which could violate the startup or settled constraints), I am adding a second-order LC filter after the full-bridge rectifier. This filter will smooth the charge pulses delivered to the final storage capacitor 'out', reducing vpp while maintaining the voltage boost provided by the SSHI stage.
